purpose: Defines the normative principles for creating and revising ADRs: what to record, how to screen content, mutability, rejection handling, placement, ID numbering, tolerance, and severity catalog.
summary: ADR definition: responsibility, what not to write, exception for approval records, lifespan
Primary beneficiary is the AI about to propose an alternative
Criteria for what to write: two conditions must hold at once; ADRs are not specs or rules
Conditions for writing the optional scope block
Screening criteria table: reject, accept after fixing, or flag as insufficient
ADRs are mutable: rewrite sections, keep section numbers, no history log
Rejection of a decision handled by rewriting the same section
Placement per feature, single file per feature, ID numbering via next-spec-id
Gray-zone tolerance table of allowed and disallowed practices
tasks: Deciding whether a decision deserves an ADR
Screening content submitted for an ADR
Numbering and placing a new ADR file
Handling a reversed or corrected decision
title: ADR（アーキテクチャ決定記録）運用原則
